text:
Every API call has a fast path

GET /items/{id}
  one row by id  →  PK
GET /items?cursor=
  mine, newest first  →  IX (owner_id, created_at)
shared with me
  rows by user  →  IX (user_id)
append event
  by parent, in order  →  partition + cluster key
